name: ChatGPT apps for customer interviews
title: ChatGPT apps for customer research interviews, compared (Nov 2026)
maintained_by: The team behind Frank AI Researcher (Prelaunch Group, Inc.). Not a paid ranking.
method: Apps found through public ChatGPT app directory mirrors on 2026-11-27, then each listing link and each vendor cell checked against that vendor's own pages on 2026-11-27. Frank cells come from the Frank docs. 'Not stated' means the vendor page we opened did not say; it does not mean the feature is missing. 'Contact vendor (per vendor site)' means no public price was shown. Competitor cells are qualitative; no competitor numbers are included.

apps.pricing: The Free plan includes 225 signup credits plus 60 voice minutes a month, no card. MCP is included on every plan.
